note: Committed successor records for handoff files/tracks that were renamed on archive or split out after the 1a/1b folds were recorded. Consumed by validate_intake._HandoffReferences. 'from' is '<file>.md' or '<file>.md#<track>'; 'to' is 'handoffs/<status>/<file>.md' or '...#<track>' (omit the fragment when the whole target file is the successor and it has no '## Track:' heading).
